User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the MandiConnect application, who can be a Farmer or Retailer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

name.description: The full name of the user.

role.description: The role of the user within the application (e.g., 'Farmer', 'Retailer').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

Listing.title: Listing
Listing.description: Represents a crop listing created by a farmer for sale in the marketplace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Listing entity.

farmerId.description: Reference to the User who created this listing.

farmerName.description: The name of the farmer who created this listing.

cropName.description: The name of the crop being listed.

quantity.description: The available quantity of the crop.

pricePerUnit.description: The desired price per unit of the crop.

phoneNumber.description: The contact phone number for this listing.

location.description: The pickup location for the crop.

status.description: The current status of the listing (e.g., 'Available', 'Sold').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the listing was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the listing was last updated.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents an order placed by a Retailer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

listingId.description: Reference to the Listing that this order is for.

farmerId.description: Reference to the User (Farmer) selling the crop.

buyerId.description: Reference to the User (Retailer) buying the crop.

definition.description: Contains crop listings created by farmers.
Manages orders between farmers and retailers.
